@SanfordBishop Federal balanced budget is recessionary. It removes too many dollars from the private sector. Federal govt never needs to save dollars but the private sector sure the does. Concord? Tool of the rich to > wealth, income, power at expense of the rest.

The $1.2 trillion spending package debate perfectly illustrates Washington's addiction to temporary fixes over structural reform. While workshops like Albany State's highlight the need for balanced priorities, Congress keeps rubber-stamping bills that balloon debt without addressing root causes. The national debt-to-GDP ratio now exceeds 120% - yet this legislation does nothing to implement enforceable spending caps or audit the $3.5 trillion in annual improper payments identified by GAO.

The Responsible Budgeting Act (H.R. 1092) proves there's a better path: tying debt ceiling increases to concrete deficit reduction of 5% GDP annually. Instead of another 1,000-page omnibus stuffed with agency bloat, we need line-item scrutiny.

Why are we funding 42,000 ICE detention beds while cutting EV infrastructure investments? Real budgeting means choosing priorities - not just adding zeros to the national credit card.
